text: imuGAP provides four bundled datasets (locations_sim, observations_sim, populations_sim, target_sim) alongside latent parameter fixtures (latent_params_sim, fit_sim, predict_sim) reflect underlying vaccination process model surveillance streams across multi-resolution hierarchical population structure. scenario: single State partitioned 3 Counties (Scruggs, Simone, Watson), contain total 24 elementary Schools (10 Scruggs, 7 Simone, 7 Watson). vaccine requires 2-dose sequential regimen (e.g. MMR, dose 1 recommended age 1 dose 2 eligible age 4). ChildVaxView / NIS-Child: State-level single-cohort point estimates ages 2 3 dose 1. SchoolVaxView: State-level kindergarten entry surveys (dose 2 age 5). TeenVaxView: State-level multi-cohort cross-sectional survey snapshots spanning ages 14 18 (dose 2). County Sixth-Grade Surveys: Right-censored dose 2 coverage age 11 across 3 counties. School Kindergarten Entry Records: Annual kindergarten entry surveys dose 2 age 5 across 24 individual schools.
